purpose: Derived display assembly; hidden mounting overlap is retained. Not a manufacturing file.
fit_stage: The fit values below describe the frame joint before leveling. The display assembly applies the same longitudinal height correction to both fitted parts.

fit.units: source CAD units, interpreted as mm; not engineering-certified

datum.front: diffuser min-Y aligned to frame min-Y
datum.axes: X width; Y USB-to-back; Z thickness

fit.frontDisplacementScope: Original-vertex seating before refinement; final front surface also receives the separately recorded projection and continuous seat recess.

residual.scope: final returned triangles after all fits: both long-side contact rails at metal exterior inset + 0.01, rear bend and final tip down to 0.003 source units before the plastic inner tip

independent_check.method: Raycast the final assembled meshes on both sides. Compare the upper and lower seats and outer skins along the straight run, verify which material is visible, and check the USB shoulders and rear return.

additional_joint_checks.method: Dense ray sampling of the fitted and leveled frame and diffuser

visual_check.pose: Orthographic side view with USB axis horizontal
visual_check.scope: Same scale and camera for both captures. Pixel heights refer to the visible metal between the two diffuser faces.
